name: Takanashi Yuuki
source:
"Member? Are you saying you want me to become a superhero too?"

A 16-year-old high schooler in Class 2-A.

An ordinary high schooler bored with her humdrum life. One night she breaks curfew and encounters a monster called a Vector. Eventually, she joins forces with the heroes who fight these beasts.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/paradox/characters/]official website[/url]]
